Hero_Desc_Speaki:
A reckless copycat phantom.
She is serious about copying a certain target.
Although it doesn't seem like she necessarily does this out of ill intent... it seems she doesn't particularly consider the feelings of her target either.
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_Speaki: A Phantom Whiz at Getting Carried Away
Album_Like_Speaki: Cinnamon Candy. Method approach in acting.
Album_Speaki1: Phantom society's perkiest phantom, known for her unrivaled frivolity, brightness, and cheerfulness. Since she looks like a phantom, I thought this all an act, but it seems this is her real personality.
Album_Speaki2: Speaki enjoys mimicking others without regard for their feelings. Thankfully, the imitations bear little resemblance to the original... But she still considers herself an unimpeachable 'identity thief.'
Album_Speaki3: Speaki particularly enjoys emulating Ner. When asked why, she says it's because the 'Yggdrasil priestess' robe' is so very pretty. Ner may have misunderstood it as vanity... I, however, have kept silent, since the truth might not please her.
Album_Speaki4: I told Speaki to stop pretending to be a priestess, and instead, suggested becoming a real one. The idea of a phantom becoming a priestess... may sound a little odd... but still. 'But I am already one,' she insists incredulously, staying true to her character.
Album_Speaki5: Perhaps due to her unique personality, Speaki is exceptionally well-liked in phantom society. She is known by everyone and has no known enemies. Being with Speaki in phantom society means avoiding deadly pranks.
Album_Speaki6: I asked Speaki if she ever disguised as herself as something other than a priestess. She boasted she was able to perfectly imitate anything in the forest. But suddenly, as if she had an epiphany, she stared at me both blankly and meaningfully.
Album_Speaki7: One day, Speaki started mimicking me. As always, her outfit was completely off, and her speech and mannerisms were still uniquely "Speaki." Still... I was rather amused than annoyed since her awkward imitation was just too funny.
LoveHero_Speaki:
Wow! It's adventure time!!
Speaki will do Ner's,
so please do Erpin's,
Master!
LoveHeroCancel_Speaki:
Speaki is being sent home?
But Speaki likes
being by the Master's side...
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Hate1: Speaki started bawling, asking if this food was made by crushing her precious friends from her garden.
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Hate2: Speaki looked a little disappointed, saying the food was lackluster and too straightforward.
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Like1: Speaki was stirred by the candy's sweet and bitter flavors, saying it reminded her of her own thorny path in life.
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Like2:
Maybe it was meant as a prank, but there were stones mixed into the food.
I was a bit worried, but Speaki shouted it was perfect for her, jumping around with excitement.
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Like3: Speaki preferred to sprinkle it around rather than eating it. She says that it makes the surroundings sparkle and makes her feel good.
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Like4: Speaki really enjoyed throwing the songpyeon to the denizens around her. All. day. long.
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Like5: She complained about preferring the taste of cinnamon. But she admitted the refreshing flavor also had its charms and enjoyed it.
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Like6: Claiming it stole the identity of the tree, Speaki loved the cake for a while, thinking that it was food meant for her.
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Like7: Speaki kept asking if the dish really didn't have any pumpkin in it before she'd eat it.
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Like8: Speaki liked it so much that she ate it as fast as she was given. When being told all Speaki's Almond Pralines were gone, she threw a tantrum, insisting she was Ner.
Food_ChefNote_Speaki_Like9: Speaki pestered me about why there wasn't a "Master" flavor. When I said Ner doesn't like pumpkin flavor, she quietly continued eating her candy.

LoveLetter_Speaki: Master! Not sure if it was yesterday or the day before, but an Apostle called Speaki asked Ner to pass along her regards to you! Ner is delivering this message word for word!Master, I am always grateful for how you've taken care of me and my pumpkin friends! If you ever visit Phantom Marsh, my pumpkin friends will look out for you and keep you safe. They'll even make sure Espi and Alice don't mess with you! You're always invited to my home anytime!
LoveCall_Speaki:
Hello, Master! It is Ner. As High Priest of the Order, I have something extremely important to tell you!

Master, what do you think of a ghost named Speaki?
Ner thinks Speaki is tremendously diligent, impressive, strong, and, um... In any case, a ghost worthy of praise!

So how about holding a pumpkin party for our Speaki?
Mm-hmm, it sounds like tremendous fun. Ner has been close to you for such a long time that I can understand your feelings instantly without even hearing your answer!

Then, now that Ner has received your permission, I shall hold the pumpkin party!
All you need to do is attend and spend a wonderful time with Speaki.
So you absolutely must come. You must~!
